meaning: Within the primary-source search space exercised by this wave, the final adversarial sweep produced no material UI decision class that required a new owner skill. This is bounded saturation, not permanent completeness.

sweeps.result: Built the v2 research, human-factors, modality, surface, AI, trust, temporal, design-ops, deep-accessibility and independent-critic faculties from gaps in the v1 47-skill graph.

Added robotics/teleoperation, ambient context-aware systems, brain-computer interaction and supervisory control-room HMI after ISO, IEC, FDA and NIST sources exposed non-decomposable decision ownership.
Added affective/adaptive UI, avatar/embodied representation and AAC communication after current ISO/IEC and W3C work exposed separate inference, identity and communication authority models.

Added cross-device action equivalence, accessibility settings/profiles, accessible media alternatives and sign-language presentation after current SC35 and ISO accessibility standards exposed distinct operation and access-channel semantics.

Added flight-deck interfaces and in-product assistance after FAA certification guidance and ISO/FDIS 9241-130 exposed aviation-specific error/automation authority and post-onboarding assistance as distinct decision classes.
Recent ISO/IEC/W3C/platform/FAA/IEC boundaries were challenged again. Every material finding decomposed into existing owners without creating an unowned decision class.

decomposition_checks.reason: Visual, auditory and tactile/haptic presentation principles refine existing presentation and modality faculties rather than introducing a new interaction authority.
Human-centred-design self-assessment is process/governance evidence; NUI already owns research validity, design governance and durable decisions.
Natural-user-interface usability evaluation changes evaluation evidence, not the underlying modality ownership.
The draft's intelligent-system categories independently reproduce the AI, robot, ambient, adaptive and multi-system boundaries already modeled by NUI.
Voice UI for personal mobility is a domain composition of voice interaction, mobility/platform constraints and cross-device action semantics.
Tactile objects, force feedback, touchables, tangibles and multimodal haptics are already owned by the haptic/motor/access faculties.
Scene-based immersive media contributes rendering and multimodal media structure; user-facing decisions decompose into spatial, media and haptic faculties.
Rehabilitation robots add medical safety and physical patient interaction to robotics; those authorities already compose without a separate UI decision owner.
Multimodal customer-service architecture combines existing modality, cross-device and temporal interaction contracts.
Current Apple guidance on refinement and feedback strengthens the existing human-AI correction and agency contracts rather than creating a new faculty.

not_claimed: comparative superiority over every external UI skill
reopen_on: new evidence invalidating an existing mechanism
an atlas cell losing a valid owner or verifier
